verdicts.reason: Quote states the requirement. Clocking is structural, so an assertion is not meaningful, but it is a requirement; check=none is acceptable only if nothing is checkable. Keep none, since it cannot be checked from interface signals.
Async reset requirement; it needs a scenario that asserts reset between clock edges.
Checkable: no handshake counted at an edge where reset is low.
Checkable at R1 from the outputs.
The condition 'until a transaction makes them 1' needs transaction context and is covered by the section 7 behaviour. A scenario is the better fit than a pure assertion.
Needs a scenario that asserts reset mid-transaction.
Scenario check after reset with a pending transaction.
Scenario with valid held through reset.
